verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions covering registration and domain management, and an official MCP server that explicitly lists "check a domain name availability" as something an agent can do. However, the API pages shown never name a specific availability search or check endpoint, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented availability/search API call, published rate limits, an OpenAPI/reference spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
